directAnswer: To use a push notification, you need to implement a service that sends notifications to users' devices, typically through a web or mobile application. Ensure that users have opted in to receive notifications.
summary: This guide provides steps to implement and manage push notifications across different platforms.

sections.heading: What is a Push Notification?
sections.body: Push notifications are messages sent from an application to a user's device, even when the app is not actively in use. They can be used for alerts, updates, or promotional content.

sections.heading: Platform-Specific Steps
sections.body: The steps to implement push notifications can vary by platform. Below are general guidelines for web and mobile applications.

steps.title: Web Push Notifications
steps.detail: 1. Register your service worker to handle push notifications. 2. Request user permission to send notifications. 3. Use the Push API to send messages to the service worker.

steps.title: Mobile Push Notifications (iOS)
steps.detail: 1. Enable Push Notifications in your Xcode project settings. 2. Register for remote notifications in your app. 3. Implement the delegate methods to handle incoming notifications.

steps.title: Mobile Push Notifications (Android)
steps.detail: 1. Add Firebase Cloud Messaging (FCM) to your project. 2. Obtain a registration token for the device. 3. Send notifications through the FCM API.

faqs.question: How can users opt out of push notifications?
faqs.answer: Users can usually opt out through the app settings or their device's notification settings.

faqs.question: Are there any costs associated with sending push notifications?
faqs.answer: Costs may vary depending on the service provider you use for push notifications, such as Firebase or OneSignal.

faqs.question: Can I customize the content of push notifications?
faqs.answer: Yes, you can customize the title, body, and actions of push notifications based on your application's needs.

caveats: User must grant permission to receive push notifications.
Push notifications may be blocked by browser settings or device settings.
